name: Gallipoli Campaign
summary: The First World War campaign fought for control of the Dardanelles.

name: Magellan's passage of the strait
summary: Ferdinand Magellan's expedition threaded the strait that now bears his name, opening a route between the oceans.

name: Opening of the Suez Canal
summary: The canal opened, joining the Mediterranean and the Red Sea and reshaping world trade routes.

name: Opening of the Seikan Tunnel
summary: The undersea rail tunnel beneath the Tsugaru Strait opened, joining Honshu and Hokkaido.

name: Opening of the Channel Tunnel
summary: The rail tunnel beneath the Strait of Dover opened, linking Britain and France.

name: Opening of the Øresund Bridge
summary: The combined rail and road bridge across the Öresund opened, linking Copenhagen and Malmö.
